title: dep-scan mcp run_scan input
description: The arguments the run_scan tool of `depscan mcp` accepts: one target and the scan options. The tool is a dry run unless the server was started with --allow-scans and the caller passes execute: true; the arguments alone can never turn a dry run into a real scan. The server validates the arguments against this schema, so an argument outside this set is a tool error rather than a silently ignored one.

target.description: What to scan: a source directory, git URL, container image reference, BOM file, BOM directory or package URL, in the form the depscan scan command accepts. A directory target must be an absolute path that resolves, with os.path.realpath, inside a root the server was started with.

execute.description: Request a real scan instead of the dry run. A real run also needs the server to have been started with --allow-scans; with execute: true but no --allow-scans the tool refuses with an error that names the flag.

reports_dir.description: The directory the scan writes its files to, as an absolute path inside the roots the server was started with. The scan chooses a directory when this is absent.

profile.description: The scan profile, one of the values the --profile option of the depscan scan command accepts.

items.description: One check to run, as the --checks option names them.

checks.description: The checks to run, as the --checks option accepts them. An explicit list defines the whole optional set; vulnerabilities always runs.

reachability_analyzer.description: The reachability analyzer to use, one of the values the --reachability-analyzer option accepts.

explain.description: Ask the scan to render its explanation, as the --explain option does.
